sources.title: Djibouti eVisa replaces point-of-entry visa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's current e-government portal confirms electronic pre-travel issuance but supplies no Greek ordinary-passport eligibility schedule or exemption list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.ss portal identifies the Interior Ministry e-visa department and was modified 22 July 2026, but it gives no Greek eligibility result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: Liberia Immigration's live official service says travellers from a country with a Liberian embassy must use that mission, preventing a passport-only Greek arrival rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa application translation
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Sierra Leone eVisa service identifies the Interior Ministry as operator; its application asset says approval ends with arrival issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once you've been approved, you'll be issued your VISA upon arrival at the Terminal.

sources.title: British Virgin Islands visitor travel documents
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government visitor page requires a visa where required but publishes no ordinary Greek-passport schedule, waiver or other status outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A valid passport and if a visa is required, it should be included in the passport before entry.

sources.title: Entry regime to Ukraine for foreign citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine's live MFA entry-regime table directly names Greece and states visa-free ordinary-passport access for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Greece | Visa-free up to 90 days within 180 days

policies.title: Greek ordinary passports: visa-free visitor access to Ukraine
policies.summary: Ukraine's Ministry of Foreign Affairs directly lists Greece for visa-free entry of up to 90 days in a 180-day period.
conditions: The published maximum is 90 days within any 180-day period.
Passport validity, martial-law restrictions, border availability, work, residence, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.
